2607.14769.title: Dialogue Summarization with Emotion Dynamics Using Topic- and Participant-Centric Decomposition
2607.14769.paper_summary: Existing text summarization research has focused much on monologic information (e.g., newspaper articles, reports) without accounting for the interaction between speakers or authors. In contrast, dialogues are a rich communication channel where multiple participants conduct back and forth exchanges to construct meaning. We propose a dialogue summarization framework that explicitly models both semantic and emotion dynamics using multimodal dialogue inputs, built on an adapted hierarchical Chain-of-Agents approach. We decompose dialogues from two perspectives: (1) topic segments based on the utterances of all participants, and (2) participant-specific utterance segments. These are used to generate corresponding summaries while incorporating automatically inferred emotions. Topic- and participant-level summaries are aggregated into a dialogue summary capturing semantic content and emotion trajectories. To evaluate beyond content accuracy, we introduce emotion trajectory metrics measuring how well summaries preserve emotional flow. Experiments with small language models on multimodal dialogue datasets show that our framework produces summaries with both semantic and emotion content. Further experiments on explicit emotion label availability highlight the efficacy of our proposed methodology and the opportunities in dialogue analysis using language models.
2607.14769.paper_summary_zh: 現有的文本摘要研究主要集中在單一信息（例如，報紙文章、報告）上，而未考慮講者或作者之間的互動。相比之下，對話是一個豐富的交流渠道，參與者之間進行來回交流以構建意義。我們提出了一個對話摘要框架，明確建模語義和情感動態，使用多模態對話輸入，基於改編的分層代理鏈方法。我們從兩個角度對對話進行分解：（1）基於所有參與者的發言的主題段落，以及（2）特定參與者的發言段落。這些用於生成相應的摘要，同時納入自動推斷的情感。主題和參與者層級的摘要被聚合成一個對話摘要，捕捉語義內容和情感軌跡。為了超越內容準確性的評估，我們引入情感軌跡指標，衡量摘要在多大程度上保留情感流。對多模態對話數據集的小型語言模型的實驗顯示，我們的框架生成的摘要同時包含語義和情感內容。進一步對明確情感標籤可用性的實驗突顯了我們提出的方法的有效性，以及使用語言模型進行對話分析的機會。
